# The Royal Clay Oven: Full Business Profile & Knowledge Base

A comprehensive guide to the authentic 100% Halal Pakistani, Tandoori, and Charcoal Grill culinary experience at The Royal Clay Oven in Shannon, County Clare, Ireland.

## 1. Restaurant Overview & Heritage
Located in the Ballycasey Craft and Design Centre in Shannon, County Clare, The Royal Clay Oven is a premier family-run establishment specializing in traditional Pakistani cuisine, high-heat brick-lined clay tandoori cooking (400°C), and open-fire charcoal grilling. Conveniently situated just 5 minutes from Shannon Airport and near the N19/M18 motorway corridor connecting Limerick and Ennis.

## 2. Dietary Standards & Halal Certification
- **100% Halal Certified**: All meats (Chicken, Lamb, Beef) are strictly certified Halal.
- **Vegetarian & Allergen Friendly**: Clear vegetarian options (Channa Masala, Falafel & Hummus, Onion Bhaji, Veg Burgers, Pizzas) and transparent EU allergen labeling (1-14 indices).
- **Fresh Clay Oven Baking**: Naan breads, rotis, and kebabs baked fresh to order in authentic tandoor clay ovens.

## 3. Location, Contact & Operating Hours
- **Physical Address**: Ballycasey Craft And Design Centre, Shannon, County Clare, Ireland.
- **Eircode**: V14 AW71
- **Telephone**: +353 61 703 636 / Mobile: +353 86 020 3720 / WhatsApp: 089 489 9950
- **Official Website**: https://www.clayoven.ie
- **Service Areas**: Shannon Town, Shannon Airport, Newmarket-on-Fergus, Bunratty, Sixmilebridge, Cratloe, and wider County Clare.

### Opening Hours:
- **Monday – Friday**: 4:00 PM – 9:30 PM
- **Saturday**: 12:00 PM – 9:30 PM (Lunch & Dinner)
- **Sunday**: 10:00 AM – 8:30 PM (Sunday Breakfast from 10:00 AM)
- *(Note: Kitchen closes 15 minutes prior to closing time)*

## 4. Complete Menu Catalog by Category

### Pakistani Cuisine (Authentic Curries served with Basmati Rice / Clay Oven Naan)
- **Butter Chicken** (€14.95): Chicken cooked in a creamy tomato butter sauce.
- **Chicken Tikka Masala** (€14.95): Grilled chicken in a rich spiced tomato sauce.
- **Lamb Karhai** (€21.95): Fragrant slow-cooked curry with tender bone-in lamb in rich, deeply spiced traditional gravy.
- **Chicken Biryani** (€14.95): Fragrant basmati rice layered with spiced chicken and aromatics.
- **Channa Masala** (€14.95, Vegetarian): Soft chickpeas cooked in a rich spiced curry sauce.
- **Pakistani Barbeque Platter** (€25.95): Mixed grilled kebabs and wings with fresh naan and mint yoghurt.
- **White Qorma** (€14.95): Mild, luxurious creamy chicken curry with delicate spices.
- **Chicken Jalfrezi** (€14.95): Chicken with peppers and onions in a spicy tangy sauce.
- **Chicken Bhuna** (€14.95): Chicken tikka in a heavy, reduced onion and tomato blend.
- **Chicken Madras** (€14.95): Hot and spicy Southern-style chicken curry.
- **Rogan Josh** (€14.95): Slow-cooked succulent chicken curry in aromatic red gravy.
